title: Galois representations and local Langlands
summary: The automorphy arguments of Chapter 10 and the final assembly use $\ell$-adic Galois representations attached to regular algebraic polarized cuspidal representations of $GL_a$ over CM fields and a local Langlands correspondence for $GL_n$ over $p$-adic fields. Both are proved in forms weaker than the published theorems: the correspondence is any map satisfying a list of laws with no $L$- or $\varepsilon$-factors, determined only on good representations (supercuspidal support in characters, or over $\mathbf Q_g$ in twists of depth-zero supercuspidals), and the Galois representations carry no polarization, no purity, and local-global compatibility only where the image of the local component is abelian and monodromy-free, or tame, monodromy-free and multiplicity-free over $\mathbf Q_g$ with $g>16a^2$. Both are Alpöge's constructions, carried out in the chapter. The Galois representations are built from seeds in the etale cohomology of PEL unitary Shimura varieties, interpolated with pseudo-characters in the manner of Chenevier-Harris, with theta lifts to definite unitary groups of large rank, descent to definite unitary groups, cyclic base change and gluing over CM extensions.
progress: Fix pass done: the statements of the division lemma, the congruences, the pair of enlargements and the plans now match the Lean; the proofs of the depth-zero lift, the split Satake parameters, the conjugate character and the bounded functional follow the Lean, with the shorter published arguments as remarks. Fifteen open steps remain; the ten new ones mark outlines not yet carried out: the crystalline comparison on test algebras (four), finiteness and the trace in the count (three), the Iwahori inverse, the stability of weak base change, and the local theta lift.

statements.statement: Setting: a number field $E$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$, a finite place $w$ and a valuation ring $A$ of $\Omega$ over $w$, with decomposition, inertia, wild inertia and Weil groups $D_A\supset W_A\supset I_A\supset P_A$ inside $\operatorname{Gal}(\Omega/E)$ and the degree $d:W_A\to\mathbf Z$.
statements.label: gal-local-situation

statements.statement: A local Artin map is a surjection $a:W_A\to E_w^\times$, continuous on inertia, with $v_w(a(\sigma))=-d(\sigma)$, through which every smooth character of $W_A$ factors, and compatible with every global reciprocity map.
statements.label: gal-local-artin

statements.reference: Local class field theory; Serre, Local class field theory, in Cassels-Fröhlich (1967)
statements.statement: There is exactly one local Artin map.
statements.label: gal-local-artin-unique

statements.statement: Frobenius-semisimple Weil-Deligne representations of $W_A$, their isomorphism classes $\mathrm{WD}(A)$, sums, tensor products, duals, twists and $\operatorname{Sp}(l)$.
statements.label: gal-weil-deligne

statements.statement: Monodromy-free, irreducible, tame (trivial on $P_A$), abelian (trivial on commutators) and multiplicity-free tame part (repeated eigenvalues of a tame generator are $(q_w-1)$-th roots of unity).
statements.label: gal-wd-classes

statements.statement: $\mathrm{WD}_\iota(r|_{W_A})$ for $w\nmid\ell$: the Frobenius semisimplification given by Grothendieck's monodromy theorem when the monodromy data exist, and the trivial representation otherwise.
statements.label: gal-wd-galois

statements.statement: Crystalline, de Rham and potentially semistable restrictions to $D_A$ for $w\mid\ell$, Hodge-Tate multisets and $\mathrm{WD}_\iota$ from $D_{\mathrm{pst}}$, all relative to axiomatized period-ring packages identified with constructions of $B_{\mathrm{cris}}$ and $B_{\mathrm{dR}}$.
statements.label: gal-p-adic-hodge

statements.statement: $\operatorname{Irr}(E_w)$, supercuspidals, supercuspidal support, segments and Langlands quotients, depth zero.
statements.label: gal-irreducible-classes

statements.statement: A supercuspidal is good if it is a character, or if $E_w\cong\mathbf Q_g$ and it is a twist by a smooth character of a depth-zero representation; a representation is good if its supercuspidal support consists of good supercuspidals.
statements.label: gal-good

statements.statement: For $E_w\cong\mathbf Q_g$: Green data (an unramified place $w'$ of residue degree $n$ of a larger number field, with its local Artin map), regular characters $\theta$ of $\mathbf F_{g^n}^\times$, cuspidal representations of $\operatorname{GL}_n(\mathbf F_g)$ attached to $\theta$ by Green's character formula, and representations of $\operatorname{GL}_n(E_w)$ containing them.
statements.label: gal-green-datum

statements.reference: Harris-Taylor (2001); Henniart, Invent. Math. 139 (2000); Scholze, Invent. Math. 192 (2013)
statements.statement: Given a local Artin map $a$, a map $\mathrm{rc}:\operatorname{Irr}(E_w)\to\mathrm{WD}(A)$ satisfies the laws if: (1) dimension; (2) $\mathrm{rc}(\chi)=\chi\circ a$; (3) compatibility with the Langlands classification by segments; (4) supercuspidals go to irreducibles; (5) $\mathrm{rc}(\pi\nu^s)=\mathrm{rc}(\pi)\otimes|\cdot|^s\circ a$; (6) $|\det\mathrm{rc}(\pi)|$ matches $|\omega_\pi\circ a|$; and only for good $\pi$: (7) twists, (8) central characters, (9) contragredients, (10) injectivity, (11) depth zero gives tame; (12) for $E_w\cong\mathbf Q_g$, a representation containing the cuspidal type attached to a regular $\theta$ goes to a monodromy-free representation whose inertia has characteristic polynomial $\prod_j(X-\theta(\bar a'(t))^{g^j})$. No $L$- or $\varepsilon$-factors, no bijectivity.
statements.label: gal-llc-laws

statements.reference: Alpoge's construction (Section section-gal-local-construction). Related to Harris-Taylor (2001), Henniart, Invent. Math. 139 (2000) and Scholze, Invent. Math. 192 (2013) only on good representations and only conditionally; uses Green, Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 80 (1955) and Zelevinsky, Ann. Sci. ENS 13 (1980)
statements.statement: For every number field $E$ and valuation ring $A$ over a finite place $w$ there are a local Artin map $a$ and a map satisfying the laws with respect to $a$. The map constructed is class field theory on characters, an explicit tame parameter from Green's parametrization on twists of depth-zero supercuspidals over $\mathbf Q_g$, a placeholder depending only on the degree and $|\omega|$ on all other supercuspidals, extended by the Langlands classification; it is not the local Langlands correspondence outside good representations.
statements.label: gal-llc-exists

statements.statement: For $E_w\cong\mathbf Q_g$ and a depth-zero supercuspidal $\rho$, an irreducible tame Weil-Deligne representation with determinant $\omega_\rho\circ a$ and the inertial characteristic polynomials of the type law is unique, and determines $\rho$ among depth-zero supercuspidals.
statements.label: gal-depth-zero-parameter

statements.statement: Any two maps satisfying the laws agree on every good representation.
statements.label: gal-llc-unique

statements.statement: The published-style characterization: bijective, laws (1)-(3), epsilon-factors of pairs via the Jacquet-Piatetski-Shapiro-Shalika functional equation with Deligne's constants, twists, central characters and contragredients for all $\pi$, supercuspidal iff irreducible, determinant characters, products, supercuspidal support, spherical iff unramified with Satake parameters, depth zero iff tame.
statements.label: gal-llc-characterization

statements.reference: Comparison with the characterization of Harris-Taylor (2001) and Henniart (2000); no published source for the laws themselves
statements.statement: Conditional: assuming the statement DepthZeroTypeInertia (every map with the published characterization satisfies the type law (12)), every map with the published characterization satisfies the laws. Neither DepthZeroTypeInertia nor the existence of a map with the published characterization (LocalLanglandsGL) is proved in the source.
statements.label: gal-llc-of-rec

statements.statement: Remark: what the laws determine (good representations only) and what the conditional comparison with the published correspondence gives.
statements.label: gal-llc-scope

statements.reference: Moy-Prasad, Comment. Math. Helv. 71 (1996); Bushnell-Kutzko (1993); Carayol, Ann. Sci. ENS 17 (1984); Green, Trans. AMS 80 (1955); Serre, Local class field theory (1967)
statements.statement: Depth-zero facts over $E_w\cong\mathbf Q_g$: a depth-zero supercuspidal contains a cuspidal type, unique up to character; containing a cuspidal type forces cuspidal and depth zero; type and central character determine the representation; scalars act on a type attached to $\theta$ by $\theta$; twists preserve depth zero exactly for tame characters; supports of depth-zero representations have depth zero; $\chi$ tame iff $\chi\circ a$ is trivial on wild inertia.
statements.label: gal-depth-zero-facts

statements.statement: Green data exist; $\bar a'$ is a surjective homomorphism $I_A\to k'^\times$ with open kernel, trivial on wild inertia, with $\bar a'(\sigma t\sigma^{-1})=\bar a'(t)^g$; $a(t)$ reduces to the norm of $\bar a'(t)$; $\bar a'(t)$ is the residue of $t(\varpi)/\varpi$ for $\varpi^{g^n-1}=g$, so it does not depend on the Green datum.
statements.label: gal-tame-inertia-character

statements.statement: From $n$ Frobenius-conjugate characters $\eta_j$ of inertia and $c\in\mathbf C^\times$, an irreducible Weil-Deligne representation of dimension $n$ with $\det V(\varphi)=c$, inertial eigenvalues $\eta_j$, tame if the $\eta_j$ are.
statements.label: gal-induced-parameter

statements.statement: Over $E_w\cong\mathbf Q_g$, every depth-zero supercuspidal has a parameter.
statements.label: gal-depth-zero-parameter-exists

statements.statement: Parameters of tame characters, of twists by tame characters and of contragredients.
statements.label: gal-parameter-operations

statements.statement: A map $r_0$ with $r_0(\chi)=\chi\circ a$, compatible with twists of good supercuspidals, and giving parameters on depth-zero supercuspidals.
statements.label: gal-good-map

statements.statement: For $n\geq2$, an irreducible $J_n$ of dimension $n$ with $|\det|=1$ that is not a twist of a tame representation when $E_w\cong\mathbf Q_g$ (induced from a wild character of inertia).
statements.label: gal-placeholder

statements.statement: A real exponent $e(x)$ with $e(x\nu^s)=e(x)+s$ that corrects $|\det|$ of a placeholder to $|\omega_x\circ a|$.
statements.label: gal-exponent

statements.statement: The laws on supercuspidals: irreducibility and dimension, characters, unramified twists, absolute central character, twists and central characters of good ones, contragredients, injectivity at good ones, depth, types.
statements.label: gal-cusp-laws

statements.statement: A map satisfying the laws on supercuspidals: $r_0$ on good supercuspidals and $J_n\otimes|\cdot|^{e(x)}\circ a$ on the others.
statements.label: gal-cusp-map

statements.reference: Langlands classification: Zelevinsky, Ann. Sci. ENS 13 (1980)
statements.statement: The Langlands extension of a map on supercuspidals through the classification by segments.
statements.label: gal-langlands-extension

statements.statement: The Langlands extension of a map with the laws on supercuspidals has dimension, characteristic polynomials and central characters from the support, twists, contragredients, injectivity at good representations and depth zero.
statements.label: gal-extension-laws

statements.statement: Cuspidal automorphic representations of $\operatorname{GL}_a(\mathbf A_E)$, local components, infinitesimal characters, regular algebraic, and polarized pairs $(\pi,\chi)$: $\chi_v(-1)=(-1)^a$ at real places and $\pi^c\cong\pi^\vee\otimes\chi\circ N\circ\det$.
statements.label: gal-polarized

statements.statement: $x$ is compatible with $y$: same dimension; $x=y$ if $y$ is abelian and monodromy-free; if $E_w\cong\mathbf Q_g$ with $n=1$ or $g>16n^2$ and $y$ is tame, monodromy-free with multiplicity-free tame part, then $x$ is monodromy-free with the same characteristic polynomials on inertia.
statements.label: gal-compatible

statements.statement: $(r,m,\mathrm{HT})$ attached to $\pi$ relative to a class of maps $\mathcal R$: $r$ continuous semisimple; away from $\ell$, $\mathrm{WD}_\iota(r)$ compatible with $\mathrm{rc}(\pi_w\nu^{(1-a)/2})$ for every $\mathrm{rc}\in\mathcal R$; Hodge-Tate weights from the infinitesimal character with the symmetry $\mathrm{HT}_{\tau c}=m-\mathrm{HT}_\tau$; above $\ell$, crystalline with these weights where $\pi_w$ is spherical, and potentially semistable with compatible $\mathrm{WD}$ in the two cases of compatibility. No polarization, no purity.
statements.label: gal-attached

statements.reference: A weak form of Barnet-Lamb, Gee, Geraghty and Taylor, Ann. of Math. 179 (2014), Theorem 2.1.1
statements.statement: Definition (the property Row0b relative to a class of maps $\mathcal R$): for every CM field $E$, $\ell$, $\iota$, $a\geq1$, regular algebraic cuspidal $\pi$ of $\operatorname{GL}_a(\mathbf A_E)$ and Hecke character $\chi$ with $(\pi,\chi)$ polarized, there is a triple attached to $\pi$ relative to $\mathcal R$. It asserts no polarization of $r$, no purity, and local-global compatibility only in the two cases of Definition gal-compatible.
statements.label: gal-galois-representations

statements.reference: Alpoge's construction (Sections section-gal-seed-construction and section-gal-construction); weaker than Barnet-Lamb, Gee, Geraghty and Taylor, Ann. of Math. 179 (2014), Theorem 2.1.1
statements.statement: Galois representations exist (Definition gal-galois-representations) relative to the class of maps satisfying the laws. The source proves the slightly stronger Row0 without the bound $g>16a^2$. Built from seeds in the etale cohomology of PEL unitary Shimura varieties, Chenevier-Harris-style interpolation with pseudo-characters, theta lifts to large definite unitary groups, descent to definite unitary groups, cyclic base change and gluing over CM extensions; no Igusa varieties and no Taylor-Wiles patching.
statements.label: gal-galois-representations-any-rc

statements.statement: Remark: by the laws, full compatibility holds where $\pi_w$ has supercuspidal support in characters and segments of length one; partial compatibility in the tame case over $\mathbf Q_g$; nothing elsewhere (e.g. Steinberg components); no polarization or purity.
statements.label: gal-galois-scope

statements.reference: Arthur-Clozel, Simple algebras, base change and the advanced theory of the trace formula (1989)
statements.statement: Let $M/K$ be a Galois extension of prime degree $p$ of totally complex fields and $\pi$ cuspidal on $\operatorname{GL}_a(\mathbf A_K)$, with no nontrivial character $\eta$ of $K^\times\backslash\mathbf A_K^\times$ of order $p$ trivial on local norms at almost all places such that the Satake parameters of $\pi$ are almost everywhere stable under $\eta$. Then there is a cuspidal $\Pi$ on $\operatorname{GL}_a(\mathbf A_M)$ with the base-change Satake parameters at unramified places, the same infinitesimal characters, and isomorphic local components at places of local degree one. Proved by strongTC_holds.
statements.label: gal-cyclic-base-change

statements.statement: The definite unitary group $U_n$ of the standard Hermitian form, its automorphic representations, local components at finite places, unramified places, Satake parameters, and weights at infinity.
statements.label: gal-definite-unitary

statements.reference: Labesse, Changement de base CM et séries discrètes (2011)
statements.statement: Let $E/F$ be CM and unramified at all finite places and $U$ automorphic on the definite $U_n$. Then there are Speh representations $V_1,\ldots,V_c$ of conjugate self-dual unitary cuspidal representations of $\operatorname{GL}_{N_i}(\mathbf A_E)$, $\sum N_i=n$, and local representations $\Pi_w$ that are subquotients of the products of local components, spherical where $U$ is unramified, with the base-change Satake parameters at inert unramified places, equal to the local component of $U$ at split places, and with the matching infinitesimal character.
statements.label: gal-base-change-definite

statements.statement: Good base for a CM field (standard additive character, CM type, split places $P$; $E/F$ unramified at finite places, $\sqrt{-d}\in E$, conditions at inert places), standard Hermitian spaces with self-dual lattices and scalar skew-Hermitian spaces with trace-dual lattices.
statements.label: gal-good-base

statements.reference: Weaker than what the stable-range theta correspondence gives: J.-S. Li, Duke Math. J. 61 (1990); Harris-Kudla-Sweet, J. Amer. Math. Soc. 9 (1996)
statements.statement: Let $E$ be CM with a good base, $n\geq1$ and $X$ a standard Hermitian space of rank $n$. There is $d_0$ such that for $d\geq d_0$, every scalar skew-Hermitian $W$ of rank $d$, unitary Hecke characters $\chi_X,\chi_W$ restricting to $\eta^n,\eta^d$ with infinity types $m_X,m_W$, and every automorphic $U$ of the definite $U_n$ of weights $\lambda$ with $d+m_W(v)\leq2\lambda(v)_k$, there is an automorphic $U'$ of the definite $U_d$ with explicitly shifted weights and related to $U$ by the local theta correspondence at every split place. It does not assert that $U'$ is the global theta lift.
statements.label: gal-theta-lift-large-rank

statements.statement: $d$-split places, lacunary sets, and seed representations for an automorphic $U$ of $U_a$: continuous semisimple $\rho$ of any dimension, unramified at almost all $d$-split places with geometric Frobenius annihilated by $\prod_b(X-q^{(a-1)/2}b)$, and with a lacunary set of $a$ Hodge-Tate weights at some place over $\ell$.
statements.label: gal-seed

statements.reference: Alpoge's construction (Section section-gal-seed-construction); geometric ingredients from Kottwitz, Invent. Math. 108 (1992); Harris-Taylor (2001); Faltings-Chai (1990)
statements.statement: Let $E$ be CM, $a$ odd, $d$ with $-d$ a square in $E$ and $\mathbf Q_\ell$, $[F:\mathbf Q]$ even, non-split places prime to $\ell$ and unramified over $F$. For an automorphic $U$ of $U_a$ unramified at non-split places outside a finite set, with a supercuspidal type at a place $w_0$ over $\ell$, Satake parameters at almost all split places and at a place $v'$ over $\ell$, and lacunary weight at $v'$: there is a seed representation; for each $d$-split place prime to $\ell$ there is one with the Frobenius condition there; and for suitable places $w$ over $\ell$ there are crystalline seeds containing the predicted Hodge-Tate weights and with crystalline Frobenius eigenvalues among $q^{(a-1)/2}B$. Proved from etale cohomology of PEL unitary Shimura varieties, a congruence relation, a holomorphic Lefschetz formula and Kodaira-Spencer; not a published theorem; proved in Section section-gal-seed-construction from packs (Hecke towers of PEL Shimura varieties), with the deepest geometric steps OPEN.
statements.label: gal-seed-representations

statements.statement: Hecke towers over a field, smooth projective towers, the $\theta$-part of total etale cohomology and its pieces, Hodge occurrence of an eigensystem.
statements.label: gal-hecke-tower

statements.statement: Good models of a Hecke tower at a place and the congruence (Eichler-Shimura) relation with its Hecke polynomial.
statements.label: gal-tower-reduction

statements.statement: The hypotheses (1)-(4) of Theorem gal-seed-representations.
statements.label: gal-seed-situation

statements.statement: A pack for $U$: smooth projective Hecke tower, eigensystem, algebraic Hecke character, congruent to $U$ at almost all $d$-split places; congruence and Hodge data at a place.
statements.label: gal-pack

statements.reference: Etale cohomology; Faltings, J. AMS 1 (1988) and Crystalline cohomology and p-adic Galois representations (1989); Katz-Messing, Invent. Math. 23 (1974)
statements.statement: Semisimple Galois pieces exist; Frobenius eigenvalues from the congruence relation; crystallinity and Hodge-Tate weights at good places over $\ell$; crystalline Frobenius divides a power of the Hecke polynomial.
statements.label: gal-tower-cohomology

statements.statement: A pack with Hodge data at a place with lacunary weight gives a seed, with the Frobenius condition at congruent places, crystallinity and Hodge-Tate weights at places with Hodge data, and crystalline Frobenius divisibility at congruent places over $\ell$.
statements.label: gal-pack-seed

statements.statement: Packs exist, from PEL Shimura varieties of unitary type (plans, Kodaira-Spencer, holomorphic Lefschetz formula), with Hodge data at $v'$ and congruence or Hodge data at a given place.
statements.label: gal-packs-exist

statements.statement: Frobenius eigenvalues at a place; weakly attached Galois representations (continuous, semisimple, Frobenius eigenvalues $q^{(a-1)/2}B$ at almost all places).
statements.label: gal-weakly-attached

statements.statement: The four conditions (unr), (dR), (crys), (phi) at a place with Satake parameters.
statements.label: gal-spherical-conditions

statements.statement: The scopes (all, good, self-dual) of polarized pairs, existence and the four conditions in a scope.
statements.label: gal-scope

statements.statement: Unlinked supports and plain representations; $\sigma^\flat=\sigma\nu^{(1-a)/2}$.
statements.label: gal-plain

statements.statement: From the four conditions in the first scope: full local-global compatibility at places with plain local component, away from and above $\ell$.
statements.label: gal-plain-compatibility

statements.statement: Inertial compatibility at depth-zero places with plain components or, over $\mathbf Q_g$, with pairwise inertially inequivalent supercuspidals of degree at least 2.
statements.label: gal-depth-zero-compatibility

statements.statement: From the four conditions in the first scope, attached triples with the tame clause over any $\mathbf Q_g$ (Row0).
statements.label: gal-row-from-core

statements.statement: From the self-dual scope to the first scope, by twisting, base change, gluing and descent.
statements.label: gal-core-all

statements.statement: Setting for definite unitary groups of odd rank: suitable CM field, $T$, $U$, two places over $\ell$.
statements.label: gal-definite-situation

statements.statement: Galois representations for automorphic representations of definite $U_a$, $a$ odd, at $d$-split places and at places over $\ell$ away from $w_0,v'$: seeds of rank $a$, congruences and trace limits.
statements.label: gal-limits

statements.statement: Existence and the four conditions in the self-dual scope: odd rank, all ranks by theta lifts and subtraction, descent to definite unitary groups, base change and gluing to all places.
statements.label: gal-core

statements.statement: Finiteness of etale cohomology of smooth projective varieties and smooth and proper base change (specialization isomorphism, Galois-equivariant, trivial inertia).
statements.label: gal-etale-foundations
statements.reference: SGA 4 (Artin-Grothendieck-Verdier 1973), Exposes XIV, XVI; Deligne, SGA 4 1/2 (1977)

statements.statement: For Y smooth projective over O_K: H^n(Y_Kbar) is crystalline, has a natural Hodge-Tate decomposition, and D_cris is crystalline cohomology of the special fibre with its Frobenius.
statements.label: gal-padic-comparison
statements.reference: Faltings, JAMS 1 (1988); Faltings, Algebraic Analysis, Geometry and Number Theory (1989)

statements.statement: Weighted traces along finite morphisms on etale cohomology with torsion and l-adic coefficients: stalkwise weighted sums, additivity in the weight, compatibility with pushing weights forward, and vanishing of a weight that vanishes over a dense set.
statements.label: gal-weighted-trace

statements.statement: Weighted finite correspondences whose 0-cycles agree over a dense set of points act equally on etale cohomology.
statements.label: gal-weighted-correspondences

statements.statement: For Y smooth proper over a DVR with correspondences satisfying the Eichler-Shimura relation at generic points of the special fibre: inertia acts trivially and sum_j (-1)^j q^{j(j-1)/2} t_j Frob^{-(n-j)} = 0 on H^k of the geometric generic fibre.
statements.label: gal-eichler-shimura-cohomology

statements.statement: Unitary PEL datum of simple type (O = O_E, odd rank n, signature (1,n-1) at one place and (0,n) elsewhere, auxiliary prime p split in Q(omega)); its Shimura variety is proper.
statements.label: gal-pel-datum

statements.statement: Holomorphic Lefschetz formula for finite etale correspondences with isolated nondegenerate fixed points on Hodge cohomology H^b(Z, Omega^a).
statements.label: gal-holomorphic-lefschetz

statements.statement: Plan: PEL datum, level, Hecke operators with eigenvalues theta, Hecke character kappa, weight lambda, test function f with the spectral condition and the congruences at almost all d-split places; Hodge data and congruence at a place.
statements.label: gal-plan

statements.statement: Hecke towers on the fibre powers of the universal abelian scheme over the PEL Shimura varieties: smooth projective, good models, congruence relations, and Hodge occurrences from the spectral condition via the holomorphic Lefschetz formula.
statements.label: gal-ks-towers

statements.statement: A plan gives a pack with the same Hodge data and congruences.
statements.label: gal-plan-pack

statements.statement: Plans exist with Hodge data at v and congruent at given places, via the identification of finite adelic groups away from p, the vector, the exponents and the spectral statement.
statements.label: gal-plans-exist

statements.statement: Generic and multiplicatively generic multisets of Satake parameters (the polynomial D_a).
statements.label: gal-generic-parameters

statements.statement: A matrix killed by prod (X - z), z in a multiplicatively generic R, with determinant prod R has characteristic polynomial prod (X - z).
statements.label: gal-char-of-ann

statements.statement: Lacunary Hodge-Tate weights give an element of the Lie algebra of the Zariski closure of the image with those eigenvalues (Sen operator).
statements.label: gal-sen

statements.statement: Division: a continuous semisimple representation of a compact group whose elements on a dense set are killed by degree-n polynomials with consistent constant term, with a lacunary Lie element, contains an n-dimensional r with det psi of which it is a quotient of copies.
statements.label: gal-division

statements.statement: From a seed for U: an a-dimensional r, unique up to isomorphism, with Frobenius eigenvalues at generic split places, crystalline with the right Hodge-Tate weights, and (phi) at generic places over l.
statements.label: gal-division-seed

statements.statement: Congruences: the Hecke eigenvalue system of U (with power sums at places over l) is approximated l-adically by those of forms with lacunary weight at v, the supercuspidal type at w0 and generic Satake parameters.
statements.label: gal-congruences

statements.statement: Limits of traces: approximated systems give a continuous trace limit, which is the trace of a continuous semisimple representation (Taylor).
statements.label: gal-trace-limit

statements.statement: Crystallinity with fixed Hodge-Tate weights, and power sums of the crystalline Frobenius, pass to trace limits.
statements.label: gal-closed-crystalline

statements.statement: For generic x with rc(x) monodromy-free: x is induced from an unlinked support with rc(x) the sum; abelian implies plain; over Q_g, tame with multiplicity-free tame part implies depth zero with pairwise inertially inequivalent supercuspidals of degree >= 2.
statements.label: gal-generic-monodromy-free
